title: 第15章 实力飙升第16章 暗处的杀手
slug: 绑定全国每人每天给我一两银
lines: 翌日清晨，睡在松软大床上的陆舟，醒来第一件事就是查看系统。
【当前云州常住人口数：87万4千5百02人！】
【今日收益：87万4千5百02两白银！】
【累计余额：201万8千9百60两白银！】
金额再次突破两百万！
他睁开双眼，嘴角微微扬起，心情大好。
“现在，可以补全功法了！”
随即，陆舟猛然起身，盘坐在床上，打开功法补全面板。
【是否消耗50万两白银补全玄元镇岳诀？】
他想都没想，直接选择补全。
在五十万两白银瞬间消失的刹那，这门一流高阶功法也终于是完整了。
【系统检测到宿主已持有完整功法，功法感悟共有四个阶段，分别是初窥门径、小有所成、出神入化以及浑然天成！】
【检测功法：一流高阶功法《玄元镇岳诀》。】
【初窥门径：消耗1万两白银；小有所成：消耗5万两白银；出神入化，消耗10万两白银；浑然天成，消耗50万两白银。】
【是否消耗白银直接进行感悟？】
“还能直接进行感悟？”
陆舟听着系统的提示音，心底掀起一阵意外。
本以为要勤学苦练……
结果没想到，这系统竟然可以直接花钱感悟功法。
还真是氪金就变强啊！
统子哥牛逼！
陆舟视线一一扫过系统文字，发现感悟整本功法需要耗费六十六万两白银。
这对于一本一流高阶功法而言，并不算多。
毕竟这等品质的功法，哪怕是那些武道天才，也需要钻研数年甚至十几年的时间。
既然花钱就能直接感悟，那自然不能辜负了统子哥的一番美意！
况且现在的银钱不足以支撑他提升到下个境界，倒不如用在功法上来提升战斗力。
一念至此，陆舟当即选择感悟。
【玄元镇岳诀感悟开始……】
刹那间，浩瀚信息涌入陆舟脑海，无数晦涩的心法口诀刻入神魂。
体内，磅礴气血在功法的转化下，逐渐转化为精纯的玄元内力。
内力奔腾，皮肉之下，筋骨震颤，每一寸血肉都得到了功法的滋养，悄然发生蜕变。
如此洗礼之下，气血愈发磅礴，骨骼显著增强，使他直接从七品高阶突破至七品顶级。
学会了功法竟然顺带着提升了一层境界？！
陆舟惊喜地感觉到那玄元内力所蕴含的恐怖能量，举手投足彷佛能引爆出巨大威能。
此刻，陆舟虽为七品，但他有信心与六品武者一战！
接下来，只需能将那逐渐生成的内气凝聚为自身内力，便可开辟丹田，成为六品武者。
届时，玄元内力与自身内力叠加，威力将会更恐怖。
这便是一流功法带来的帮助！
顷刻间便掌控了如此一门功法……
content_en:
The next morning, Lu Zhou, who was sleeping on a big, soft bed, woke up and the first thing he did was check the system.
[The current permanent population of Yunzhou: 874,502 people! 】
[Today’s income: 874,502 taels of silver! 】
[Cumulative balance: 2,018,960 taels of silver! 】
The amount exceeded two million again!
He opened his eyes, raised the corners of his mouth slightly, and was in a good mood.
"Now, you can complete your skills!"
Immediately, Lu Zhou stood up suddenly, sat cross-legged on the bed, and opened his exercises to replenish his face.
[Should I spend 500,000 taels of silver to complete the Xuanyuan Zhenyue Jue? 】
Without thinking, he just chose to complete it.
At the moment when five hundred thousand taels of silver disappeared in an instant, this first-class high-level skill was finally complete.
[The system detects that the host has mastered the complete technique. There are four stages in the comprehension of the technique, which are first glimpse of the door, small success, mastery and natural perfection! 】
[Testing skills: First-class high-level skills "Xuanyuan Zhenyue Jue". 】
[First glimpse of the method: consumes 10,000 taels of silver; small success: consumes 50,000 taels of silver; reaching perfection, consumes 100,000 taels of silver; completely natural, consumes 500,000 taels of silver. 】
[Should I consume silver to gain enlightenment directly? 】
"Can we still comprehend it directly?"
Lu Zhou listened to the system prompts and felt a sense of surprise in his heart.
I thought I had to study hard and practice hard...
Unexpectedly, this system can actually spend money to learn the skills.
It’s true that krypton gold can make you stronger!
Brother Tongzi is awesome!
Lu Zhou glanced at the system text one by one and found that it would cost 660,000 taels of silver to comprehend the entire technique.
This is not much for a first-rate high-level skill book.
After all, even those martial arts geniuses need to study for several years or even more than ten years to develop techniques of this quality.
Since you can directly appreciate it by spending money, you can’t live up to Brother Tongzi’s kindness!
Besides, the current money is not enough to support him to advance to the next level, so it is better to use it on skills to improve his combat effectiveness.
After thinking this, Lu Zhou immediately chose to realize it.
[The understanding of Xuanyuan Zhenyue Jue begins...]
In an instant, vast amounts of information poured into Lu Zhou's mind, and countless obscure mental formulas were engraved into his soul.
Within the body, the majestic energy and blood are gradually transformed into pure Xuanyuan internal force under the transformation of the technique.
The internal energy surges, and under the skin and flesh, the muscles and bones tremble. Every inch of flesh and blood is nourished by the technique and undergoes transformation quietly.
Under such baptism, his Qi and blood became more powerful, and his bones were significantly strengthened, allowing him to directly break through from the high level of the seventh level to the top level of the seventh level.
After learning the exercises, I actually improved to a higher level? !
Lu Zhou was pleasantly surprised to feel the terrifying energy contained in the inner force of Xuanyuan, and his movements seemed to be able to detonate huge power.
At this moment, although Lu Zhou was at the seventh level, he was confident of fighting against a sixth-level warrior!
Next, as long as you can condense the gradually generated inner energy into your own inner strength, you can open up your Dantian and become a sixth-grade warrior.
By then, Xuanyuan's internal power will be superimposed on his own internal power, and the power will be even more terrifying.
This is the help brought by first-class exercises!
He mastered such a skill in an instant...
